Methodology.title: About the data
Methodology.description: How records are published, how to assess their scope, and what to check before using results.
Methodology.visibilityBody: Catalog records include names, versions, scope, sources, and available quality information. Inputs, outputs, and LCIA results appear only when released for public use.
Methodology.comparabilityBody: Compare results only when functional unit, reference flow, method, geography, time, and system boundary are compatible.
Methodology.provenanceBody: Record pages distinguish documented source information from search assistance. Missing source information remains unfilled.
Methodology.withdrawalBody: Each dataset version has its own link. Withdrawn or restricted content is removed from the catalog.
Methodology.licensingBody: A public catalog entry does not by itself grant permission to reuse the underlying data. Review the source and licence for each version; inputs, outputs and impact results have separate availability indicators.
Methodology.searchHelpBody: Describe the dataset you need, including product, geography, period and technology. The Portal can show initial keyword matches while it prepares results for your description. These are search suggestions, not a scientific review or an AI-generated dataset.
Methodology.selectionHelpBody: Use a shortlist to keep Process and Flow versions with your notes. Comparison accepts 2–4 Process versions and checks the displayed fields. Check system boundaries and study suitability yourself, and export a shortlist backup before changing browsers.
